mechanisms.mechanism_description: Expert agent introduces a percentage range in a rewrite to replace an 'every X' or 'most X' overclaim from the slide. The specific range is not in the dossier; it's a 'reasonable-sounding' fabrication added during the rewrite step.

Rewrite attributes a category-level statistic from a third-party source (e.g., an industry-survey percentage) to a specific named firm, when the original source does NOT name that firm. Numeric value is correct; the entity binding is fabricated.

first_caught.specific_value: industry stat misattributed to a named firm

mechanisms.mechanism_description: Slide presents a quote in quotation marks attributed to a named living author, but the text is a paraphrase rather than verbatim. WebFetch on the source URL (when present) confirms mismatch. Risk: shipping a misattribution under quote marks is harder to defend than a paraphrase.

first_caught.specific_value: a named author's newsletter quote — paraphrase shipped as verbatim
